metrics.name: measured_import_kwh
metrics.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN meter_readings.quality_status = 'VALID' AND meter_readings.is_estimated = 'false'
      THEN meter_readings.import_kwh
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS measured_import_kwh
FROM meter_readings AS meter_readings
LIMIT 201
metrics.reference_sql:
SELECT SUM(import_kwh) AS measured_import_kwh
FROM meter_readings
WHERE quality_status = 'VALID'
  AND is_estimated = 'false'
